summary: Staff and admin WorkspaceLayout uses Direction B Glass Studio chrome on the shared teal gradient, with solid fallbacks and updated design docs.
detailed_changes: WorkspaceLayout: gradient shell, frosted glass rail/chrome, near-opaque canvas; a11y drawer behaviour unchanged.
Extended CSS glass fallbacks for workspace classes when backdrop-filter is unsupported or prefers-reduced-motion.
Added direction-b-glass-studio-ui.md; updated tokens.md, Direction C OOS notes, and component inventory.
affected_areas: Page or route: all staff/admin pages using WorkspaceLayout
User groups affected: staff and admin editors
Public impact: none (public Direction C unchanged)
Internal impact: Glass Studio shell for authenticated workspaces
